source.title: Na krilima Duha E11: Duhovnost sv. Atanazija Velikog - don Mladen Parlov

summary.title_hr: Na krilima Duha E11: Duhovnost sv. Atanazija Velikog - don Mladen Parlov
summary.abstract_hr: U jedanaestoj epizodi podcasta Mreže Riječi „Na krilima Duha” voditelj otvara ciklus o crkvenim ocima 4. stoljeća i predstavlja svetoga Atanazija Velikoga, rođenog u Aleksandriji, koji se ubraja među četiri velika istočna crkvena oca. Opisuje se pojava arijanizma, koji je Logos smatrao nižim, posredničkim bićem, te Nicejski koncil iz 325. godine, na kojem je Atanazije kao mladi đakon pratio biskupa Aleksandra i na kojem je pojmom istobitnosti (homoousios) obranjeno Kristovo božanstvo. Govori se o Atanazijevim pet progonstava, njegovoj obrani božanstva Krista i Duha Svetoga te o središnjem pojmu njegove teologije, pobožanstvenjenju (theosis). Posebno se ističe utjecaj njegova spisa o životu svetog Antuna Pustinjaka na razvoj monaštva na Istoku i Zapadu. Zaključna je poruka da je vjera blago vrijedno svake žrtve te da kršćani istinu u Isusu Kristu trebaju svjedočiti i u današnjem relativističkom svijetu.
key_topics: božanstvo isusa krista i duha svetoga
život svetog antuna pustinjaka i monaštvo
key_points: Arije je kršćansku poruku pokušao prilagoditi grčkoj misli, učeći da je samo Otac pravi Bog, a Logos niže, posredničko biće. Taj je nauk prema voditelju u jednom trenutku prihvatilo gotovo više od polovice biskupskih stolica.

Nicejski koncil, koji je sazvao car Konstantin 325. godine, obranio je Kristovo božanstvo pojmom istobitnosti (homoousios). Arijanizam je osuđen, ali nije nestao, a kasniji su ga carevi ponovno podupirali.
Atanazije je postao aleksandrijski biskup 328. godine i bio je najžešći branitelj nicejskog pravovjerja. Zbog toga je pet puta išao u progonstvo i u njemu proveo ukupno 17 godina.

Atanazijeva argumentacija temelji se na spasenju: ako Logos i Duh Sveti nisu Bog, ljudi nisu spašeni ni pobožanstvenjeni. Krist je postao čovjekom da ljude pobožanstveni, a to djelo u njima ostvaruje Duh Sveti.

Spis o životu Antuna Pustinjaka (Vita Antonii) prikazuje pustinju kao bojište Kristova vojnika. Nakon prijevoda na latinski dao je novi poticaj zapadnom monaštvu, a voditelj smatra mogućim da je potaknuo i svetog Jeronima na monaški život.
Prema poruci Atanazijeva života, vjera je toliko veliko blago da je vrijedna svake žrtve, pa i žrtve života. Atanazije nije odstupao od istine ni pred carevima ni pred drugim biskupima.
Voditelj ističe da je ta poruka aktualna u današnjem svijetu relativizma. Za kršćane istina ima ime, Isus Krist, i treba je svjedočiti, a ne zadržati za sebe.
key_topics_en: divinity of jesus christ and the holy spirit
life of saint anthony the great and monasticism
key_points_en: Arius attempted to adapt the Christian message to Greek thought, teaching that only the Father is true God, while the Logos is a lower, intermediary being. According to the host, that teaching was at one point accepted by almost more than half of the episcopal sees.

The Council of Nicaea, convened by Emperor Constantine in 325, defended Christ's divinity through the concept of consubstantiality (homoousios). Arianism was condemned, but it did not disappear, and later emperors supported it again.
Athanasius became Bishop of Alexandria in 328 and was the fiercest defender of Nicene orthodoxy. Because of this, he went into exile five times and spent a total of 17 years in it.

Athanasius's argumentation is based on salvation: if the Logos and the Holy Spirit are not God, humans are neither saved nor divinized. Christ became human to divinize humans, and that work is realized in them by the Holy Spirit.

The writing on the life of Anthony the Great (Vita Antonii) depicts the desert as the battlefield of a soldier of Christ. Following its translation into Latin, it gave fresh impetus to Western monasticism, and the host considers it possible that it also inspired Saint Jerome toward monastic life.

According to the message of Athanasius's life, faith is such a great treasure that it is worthy of every sacrifice, even the sacrifice of one's life. Athanasius did not deviate from the truth either before emperors or before other bishops.
The host emphasizes that this message is timely in today's world of relativism. For Christians, truth has a name, Jesus Christ, and it must be witnessed to, not kept to oneself.
summary.title_en: On the Wings of the Spirit E11: Spirituality of St. Athanasius the Great - don Mladen Parlov
summary.abstract_en: In the eleventh episode of the Mreža Riječi podcast "On the Wings of the Spirit", the host opens a series on the Church Fathers of the 4th century and presents Saint Athanasius the Great, born in Alexandria, who is counted among the four great Eastern Church Fathers. The emergence of Arianism is described, which considered the Logos to be a lower, intermediary being, as well as the Council of Nicaea in 325, at which Athanasius as a young deacon accompanied Bishop Alexander and at which Christ's divinity was defended through the concept of consubstantiality (homoousios). Athanasius's five exiles are discussed, his defense of the divinity of Christ and of the Holy Spirit, and the central concept of his theology, divinization (theosis). Particularly emphasized is the influence of his writing on the life of Saint Anthony the Great on the development of monasticism in the East and West. The concluding message is that faith is a treasure worthy of every sacrifice and that Christians must witness to the truth in Jesus Christ also in today's relativistic world.
